## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check .` is clean
- [ ] `uv run mypy` passes (strict)
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] No new dependency, or it was agreed in an issue first
- [ ] Anything new in the window can also be done from the command line
- [ ] No recording can be deleted or overwritten by it
- [ ] Nothing is sent off the computer
